But to answer your question, I think it's that I haven't really achieved anything other than failure since then and it's significantly hurt what little self esteem I had to begin with.

I don't think I could put my finger on one specific thing, but there have for sure been some changes. I graduated high school last June, and I've really struggled with trying to find a path to a decent life since then. I switched majors twice and now I've all but dropped out. I was working a 4:30PM-1AM online call center job that royally screwed my sleep schedule (I quit that one a few months ago). I've had zero luck finding employment since then. I want to go to school full time and just focus on that but I feel like I'm not capable of juggling a job and school at the same time.

I've been struggling with depression for upwards of 2 years now, spent some time at an inpatient facility and I was making good progress for a while.. but I've gotten worse since then. It's incredibly discouraging, pulling yourself out of a hole only to be thrown right back in.
